sources.title: Škoda Scala/Kamiq EA211 evo2 update
sources.accessNote: Later 1.0 TSI evo2 is 115 PS, 4 kW above predecessor; it does not support the 110 PS label.

sources.title: Škoda Slovakia — Scala technical data, 1.0 TSI 81 kW (110 KM)
sources.accessNote: Official Slovak market technical table lists 1.0 TSI 81 kW/110 KM with 6-speed manual and 7-speed automatic. Paired with other official documents, this corrects the old claim that 110 KM was unsupported; Polish market year availability and engine code require VIN confirmation.

sources.title: ADAC — Škoda Scala specifications and model-level breakdown statistics
sources.accessNote: Scala-level breakdown data and recall information; the opened variant page is the 70 kW 95 PS model, not engine-specific evidence for 81/85 kW.

sources.title: Poruchovost.cz — Škoda Scala inspection data by powertrain grouping
sources.accessNote: Czech official STK-derived vehicle inspections report separate 81 kW and 85 kW groups; outcomes are whole-vehicle defects, not engine failure rates, and this is not independent of other Czech STK aggregators.
